n: LLMs Unplugged Fine-tuning and LoRA module
t: A paper module that adds new text to a finished model through an adapter sheet.
steps: Find the LLMs Unplugged site and open the modules page.
Run the Training and Generation modules first.
Open the Fine-tuning and LoRA module page.
Print the sheets or cutouts from the site.
Gather pens, paper, and dice. Use a d10 for the grid activities.
Plan 50 to 60 minutes, plus 20 for the flattering adapter.
Check the content license stated on the site.
